# Frontend Design

Use for React, HTML, CSS, visual design, user interface, and polished web page work.

## When to Use

- Build or refine a React page, web layout, design system, or user-facing interface.
- Trigger with requests such as "polish this dashboard" or "create a frontend page".

## When Not to Use

- Do not use this skill for backend database migrations or infrastructure-only changes.
